summary: Provident Financial Services Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $175 million offering of 6.50% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes mature September 1, 2036, with a fixed rate period ending September 1, 2031, then floating at SOFR plus 239 basis points. Redemption options begin September 1, 2031, subject to Federal Reserve approval. The notes are unsecured, subordinated obligations not listed on any exchange and uninsured by the FDIC. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
